description: This file defines macros for unit testing assertions and extends NSException with additional failure methods. It is part of a testing framework, specifically for the GTMSenTestCase class, providing various test assertions and exception handling utilities.

classes.name: NSException (GTMSenTestAdditions)
classes.description: Category adding failure methods for testing purposes.

classes.name: GTMTestCase
classes.description: Subclass of SenTestCase that manages test case behavior, including handling of abstract test cases.

methods.name: failureInFile:atLine:withDescription:
methods.description: Creates an NSException indicating a failure at a specific file and line with a description.

methods.name: failureInCondition:isTrue:inFile:atLine:withDescription:
methods.description: Creates an NSException indicating a failure of a condition check.

methods.name: failureInEqualityBetweenObject:andObject:inFile:atLine:withDescription:
methods.description: Creates an NSException indicating inequality between two objects.

methods.name: failureInEqualityBetweenValue:andValue:withAccuracy:inFile:atLine:withDescription:
methods.description: Creates an NSException indicating inequality between two NSValues within an accuracy.

methods.name: failureInRaise:exception:inFile:atLine:withDescription:
methods.description: Creates an NSException indicating a failure in raising an exception.
